statement: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_pairwise_estimates_20260612 AS WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_channel_labels_20260612 WHERE topic_category_count > 0), exploded AS (SELECT split, channel_id, pos, topic_category FROM base LATERAL VIEW posexplode(topic_categories) e AS pos, topic_category), totals AS (SELECT split, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id) AS n_transactions FROM base GROUP BY split), label_stats AS (SELECT split, topic_category, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id) AS n_label, AVG(pos) AS avg_position, SUM(CASE WHEN pos = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_first_position FROM exploded GROUP BY split, topic_category), pair_counts AS (SELECT a.split, a.topic_category AS antecedent_label, b.topic_category AS consequent_label, COUNT(DISTINCT a.channel_id) AS n_cooccurring, AVG(CASE WHEN b.pos < a.pos THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS pct_consequent_before_antecedent, AVG(CAST(b.pos - a.pos AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_position_delta_consequent_minus_antecedent FROM exploded a INNER JOIN exploded b ON a.split = b.split AND a.channel_id = b.channel_id AND a.topic_category <> b.topic_category GROUP BY a.split, a.topic_category, b.topic_category), metrics AS (SELECT pc.split, pc.antecedent_label, pc.consequent_label, la.n_label AS n_antecedent, lb.n_label AS n_consequent, pc.n_cooccurring, t.n_transactions, pc.pct_consequent_before_antecedent, pc.avg_position_delta_consequent_minus_antecedent, pc.n_cooccurring / la.n_label AS confidence, pc.n_cooccurring / lb.n_label AS reverse_confidence, (pc.n_cooccurring * t.n_transactions) / (la.n_label * lb.n_label) AS lift, (pc.n_cooccurring / la.n_label) - (pc.n_cooccurring / lb.n_label) AS confidence_asymmetry, la.avg_position AS antecedent_avg_position, lb.avg_position AS consequent_avg_position, la.n_first_position / la.n_label AS antecedent_first_position_rate, lb.n_first_position / lb.n_label AS consequent_first_position_rate FROM pair_counts pc INNER JOIN label_stats la ON pc.split = la.split AND pc.antecedent_label = la.topic_category INNER JOIN label_stats lb ON pc.split = lb.split AND pc.consequent_label = lb.topic_category INNER JOIN totals t ON pc.split = t.split) SELECT *, ((confidence + (1.96 * 1.96) / (2.0 * n_antecedent) - 1.96 * sqrt((confidence * (1.0 - confidence) + (1.96 * 1.96) / (4.0 * n_antecedent)) / n_antecedent)) / (1.0 + (1.96 * 1.96) / n_antecedent)) AS confidence_wilson_lower_95 FROM metrics
